articles.title: Zoetis to Host Webcast and Conference Call on First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.mainIdea: Zoetis to Host Webcast and Conference Call on First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.summary: Business Wire: Zoetis to Host Webcast and Conference Call on First Quarter 2026 Financial Results. PARSIPPANY, N.J., April 02, 2026--Zoetis Inc. (NYSE:ZTS) will host a webcast and conference call at 8:30 a.m. (ET) on Thursday, May 7, 2026. Chief Executive Officer Kristin Peck and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Wetteny Joseph will review first quarter 2026 financial results and respond to questions from financial analysts.
